description: A configurable 2D game character sprite: original adult male superhero, much taller and broader than the others. Square jaw, short neat black hair, and a very large thick clean black mustache that is the most distinctive facial feature. Wears a clean white/light-gray full suit with red chest section, red cape hanging from shoulders, red gloves, red boots. Upright authoritarian posture, broad shoulders, completely rigid and commanding presence. No mask.
